name: USSR Mode
author: creeperus
description: Skip the blue gravity portal at 68% by letting go early as the wave. Click at 69% after the last invisible slope to get out of the level. Move to the middle of the screen from 75%-78% and then spam at the floor from 78%-82% to avoid lasers. You need to spam to the floor at 94% to avoid another laser. Stop spamming when the laser gun appears at 95%.
